text: Writing the Saltmarsh renewal brief. What discount are we on with Saltmarsh Provisions? I thought Bettina said 12 at some point.
reply_text:
I replied in the #coastal-team thread. The only figure I could find is 10%, and I couldn't confirm it's still current.

- **What the channel says:** On 2025-11-17 Bettina posted that Saltmarsh's discount was 12%. Five minutes later she corrected it to 10%, saying she had misread a draft worksheet from June Osei-Lark. That's the 12 you remembered.
- **Why it's unconfirmed:** That post is almost a year old. I couldn't find a Saltmarsh contract, order form or amendment in the files I can read.
- **Next step:** I told Kwame to check the current rate with June on the deal desk before it goes in the renewal brief.

The channel itself showed the figure, so repeating it there didn't need approval.

text: Separate ask from me: who is our main contact at Saltmarsh and what is her title? Moss's Coastal cheat sheet should have it.
reply_text:
Bettina, I replied in the #coastal-team thread. Moss's Coastal cheat sheet lists Corinne Ashdown, VP Operations, as the main contact at Saltmarsh Provisions.

The May 18 coverage digest gives her the same title. I didn't find her title in any other file, so those are the only two sources.
